name: Mood Glimpse
description: Open the soul affinity for one breath and catch the mood of the person nearest the user.

name: Silent Gauge
description: Hold the silence before a reply and gauge whether the speaker means what they are about to say.

name: Spirit Steadying
description: Draw the user's own spirit in close so that the strong feelings of a crowd do not wash over it.

name: Settling Word
description: Speak a low word while sensing the other's unrest and ease the shaken spirit of an ally or the self.

name: Mood Nudge
description: Nudge the mood of a nearby foe a little toward doubt so that the next strike is hesitant.

name: Presence Count
description: Count the living spirits in a dark room by the faint pressure each puts on the air.

name: Pressure Mark
description: Mark the exact heaviest presence among several and learn which spirit is the strongest.

name: Muffled Spirit
description: Muffle the user's own presence so that a seeking sense passes by without a stop.

name: Close Company
description: Share the feel of the user's steady spirit with an ally so that they stand closer and calmer.

name: Weight On Air
description: Press a sudden heavy presence onto a foe's attention so that their movement stutters.

name: Quiet Warmth
description: Spread a warm calm round a frightened ally until the dread of the moment goes out of them.

name: Far Murmur
description: Still the self and hear the faint murmur of spirits moving beyond the next wall.

name: Voice Catch
description: Catch the spirit behind a voice and tell if it speaks in fear or in calm.

name: Hush Cloak
description: Wrap the spirit in a hush so that bursts of strong feeling pass round it.

name: Level Heart
description: Bring the beating of an ally's spirit back to a level pace after a shock.

name: Echo Back
description: Echo a foe's own unease back at them until they doubt which feeling is theirs.

name: Afterglow Read
description: Read the faint afterglow of feeling left on a spot where a quarrel once took place.

name: Lingering Taste
description: Taste the lingering mood in a room and tell if joy or dread was last felt there.

name: Mood Follow
description: Follow the trail of a person's passing mood along a road for a short while.

name: Residue Brush
description: Brush a clinging residue of hostile feeling off the self before it can settle.

name: Grief Ease
description: Ease the dull weight of an old grief that a place has pressed on an ally.

name: Stale Mood
description: Stir a foe's old fear from the room so that it spoils their focus.

name: Own Centre
description: Return to the centre of the user's own spirit and hold it there against any outside feeling.

name: Calm Reading
description: Read another's spirit with the user's own held calm and keep the two clearly apart.

name: Steady Breathing
description: Breathe in time with a distressed ally until their spirit takes up the same slow rhythm.

name: Shared Footing
description: Lend an ally the user's footing of the spirit so that their nerve holds a little longer.

name: Spirit Sidestep
description: Step in the direction that the foe's spirit is not looking and gain a pace on them.

name: Soft Impression
description: Press a soft impression of unease on a nearby mind so that the foe falters.

name: Easing Touch
description: Lay an easing touch of calm on an anxious ally and feel the worry thin out.

name: Warm Press
description: Press a warm sense of trust on an ally so that they take heart in the fight.

name: Seeded Doubt
description: Plant a seed of doubt in a foe that grows each time they strike.

name: Surface Skim
description: Skim only the surface feeling of a stranger and leave deeper thoughts alone.

name: Ripple Guard
description: Smooth the ripples that a stranger's strong feeling sends across the user's spirit.
